milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the heavy weighted pressure plate and face it to demonstrate visual identification. Target is (5, 0, 0) where the pressure plate sits on a polished andesite block within the gold block platform on the east side of the room. max_distance=5 (tightened from 16 per Validator feedback) ensures the player must actually walk toward the gold platform area rather than just rotating the camera from spawn (~5 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the pressure plate, not just standing nearby.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the lodestone and face it to demonstrate visual identification. Target is (-5, 1, -5) where the lodestone sits on a polished blackstone brick pedestal in the northwest corner with a soul lantern above. max_distance=8 (tightened from 16 per Validator feedback) ensures the player must move toward the northwest corner (~7 blocks diagonal from spawn) rather than completing from the spawn point. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the lodestone.
